scene: At a stone hilltop lookout after sunset, she looks through plain compact binoculars toward the lower mountain ridges beneath the first stars; cool blue twilight, a warm side lantern, and a broad view across the valley.
outfit: A deep-green boat-neck long-sleeve ribbed top, its neckline sitting evenly along both collarbones, ending at the waist; separate ivory wide-leg trousers and an earth-brown hip-length open waistcoat with small oak-leaf earrings.
custom: Both bare hands support the separate binocular barrels; the optical tubes have plain surfaces without labels.
